nativeGeometryComposition.coverage: All 17 finite scenes, all 53 aspect variants, all themes with 7/8/9 board geometry, viewport/safe-area/pause bounds

operationCounts.observation: Complex static path calls removed from dense classic 7/8/9 board fixture; simple board gradients retained. Four-card preview call counts substantially reduced.
operationCounts.limitation: Deterministic method counts, not device frame-time or FPS.

reviewedIntegrationEvidence.android: Web staging verification passes with bootstrap publishApk=false; no APK compilation or CI execution

sourceReviewConclusions: Exact saved effective appearance is prepared before gameplay; failures expose retry without substituting default art or changing selection.
Loading-started gestures cannot become gameplay releases; hide/show cancellation and blocked gameplay clocks are preserved.
Sequential loading retains at most one current and one in-flight scene; obsolete completion is discarded and preview references are bounded.
WeChat cosmetics loader is lazy, API-guarded, shares concurrent package work and permits explicit retry. Browser/Android relative assets are fully local.
Warehouse and cosmetic offscreen-cache wiring is removed from runtime entry points; mature dynamic text, traits, motion, input and preview calculations remain.
Frozen design source, 17 scenes, 19 complete vehicles including retired compact, 75 premium cargo bodies, classic colors, waste/outline, tools and 53 preview architectures are preserved.
Accepted grouped-alpha compositing difference is visible and documented accurately; semantic glyphs, cargo colors, outline and countdown remain clear in inspected samples.
limitations: The full suite is not all green: the two inherited missing-authoring-source failures remain.
No physical-phone, WeChat developer-tool, processed-upload-size, native/GPU peak-memory, or audible-output validation was performed.
The v111/v112 phone black-screen cause is unconfirmed; this migration is not proof of a phone fix.
No APK was compiled, signed, delivered, or published. No Android CI or public release was triggered.
git diff --check reports only preserved raw-log whitespace and a blank EOF line copied verbatim from frozen baseline authoring source; these are non-runtime evidence/source-preservation nits.
